messages:
alex: quick q — about tonight's prod debug: if I need to SSH into the jump host to grab a process stack, what's the approved minimal steps? don't want to mess up runbook or leak creds :grimacing:

maria: short answer: follow the runbook section 'live-debug' + open a temporary access ticket. no plain-text creds. :+1:

alex: got it. specific questions: 1) can I scp logs locally for faster grep? 2) are we ok pasting snippets in #eng-support (with redaction)?

tony: 1) avoid scp unless you open a data-movement approval in the ticket. prefer zcat|grep or use the ephemeral analyst VM that has pulled logs. 2) paste only redacted lines, replace tokens with [REDACTED].

sasha: add: always mask PII + auth tokens. quick regex we use in runbook for redaction: ``s/([a-z0-9]{20,})/[REDACTED_TOKEN]/g``. also capture the audit id from the session and paste it into the ticket.

alex: thx. where's the session audit id stored? I couldn't find in the runbook last night.

maria: the oncall jump host agent writes it to /var/log/jump-audit.log and we ship a copy to splunk under index=prod_audit. runbook has the exact path in the 'post-debug checklist' but i'll patch it to be clearer.

oncall-bot: NOTE: ephemeral SSH sessions require approval tag: "oncall-debug" in the ticket. All sessions are recorded and archived for 90 days.

alex: perfect. last: is sudo allowed or do I need a specific escalation?

tony: sudo is restricted. if you need root, request a short-lived sudo via the ticket; an approver (pager or sec oncall) must grant it. process: create ticket -> request short-lived-sudo -> include reason + command to run -> approver grants with expiry.

alex: will follow. i'll open the ticket now and update the runbook if maria pushes the audit path clarity. thanks folks. :pray:

maria: thanks — if anyone hits ambiguity while i'm AFK, ping @sasha and mention 'runbook-redaction' tag. i'll make the runbook edit tomorrow morning. :memo:

tony: small tip for posting snippets: run them through this scrub before pasting:```bash
# scrub tokens and emails
sed -E 's/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/[REDACTED_EMAIL]/g' /tmp/out.log | sed -E 's/[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}/[REDACTED_TOKEN]/g'
```

alex: added the ticket with id PROD-4821 and tag oncall-debug. i'll attach the audit id once I SSH.```
